text: Cooking is a delightful culinary art where ingredients come together to create a harmonious balance of flavors and textures. One essential ingredient that enhances the depth of many dishes is garlic, a bulb of pungent, aromatic flavor that adds a unique character to various meals. Garlic can be sautéed, minced, or roasted, depending on the recipe, to release its natural oils and bring out its richness. Onions, on the other hand, are crucial in adding sweetness and depth to many dishes, often being sautéed in olive oil until caramelized for a sweet and savory flavor. Together, garlic and onions are a fundamental duo in cooking, adding layers of flavor and aroma to a wide range of recipes.
